nativeArtifact.description: Installed official Rapier compatibility ESM including inlined WASM; dependency artifact identity, not owned application source.

cpuGate.scope: Current-source native controller CPU only. Historicalheap/fullhardware obligations not waived; no Done claim.

backend: Real Rapier, unpaced Node CPU; no browser/GPU/FPS measurement
workload: Same manyContacts70 inputs and flat surface; actual unified AUTO controller at 60Hz with fresh targets at 10Hz
observerComparison: ON includes native PhysicsCosts instrumentation and external whole-step timer; same instrumentation must be used after. OFF has only elapsed wall total. Compare ON percentiles against ON before; no OFF percentile or per-decision overhead claim.
ownership: 10 sequential worlds disposed and native read rejected; this is not a 20-cycle lifecycle test.
scope: One required current-source validation after actual published027 dependency integration. Exact originalv5 protocol with defaultdrivetrainopt-in absent, same chronologicalreference, no new baseline/threshold or speculativeoptimization. CPU-only no fullgame/hardware/heap acceptance; preserveallpreviousFAIL.

runs.rawTimingScope: ON retains all600 ordered measured durations; OFF has no per-tick clocks as original protocol and is explicitly null, not reconstructed.
runs.incrementalScope: External whole-controller elapsed minus wrapped physical-port elapsed; includes admission, arbitration, realization, actuation dispatch, descriptor validation and two extra clocks. Packet preparation and semantic assertions occur outside sampled controller timing. Elapsed wall total includes them and remains diagnostic. Not a separately isolated algorithm timer.
